title: Archdiocese of New York agrees to $800 million settlement over sexual abuse claims
content: The 1,300 survivors of sexual abuse by clergy members and lay workers have all agreed to the settlement, according to an attorney for some of the plaintiffs.

title: Trade tariffs cause whiplash at Port Milwaukee
content: Sacha Pfeiffer visits Port Milwaukee to see how President Trump's tariffs have affected the flow of goods and impacted the regional economy.

title: How data centers became a bipartisan political issue in Wisconsin
content: Data centers are a big issue across the country. As midterms approach, many look to the swing state of Wisconsin for lessons for how that issue could play out nationally.

title: Ukraine says Starlink is back to normal after disruptions
content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that normal Starlink operating speeds were restored after more than a week of disruptions.

title: Perspective: The next James Bond
content: A new James Bond is nigh, to replace the last actor in the 64 year-old movie franchise. What evil forces will the new 007 face? Killer Drones? Killer AI? Killer lettuce?

title: Gunmen open fire at a church during a funeral in Jordan, killing 7 and wounding 40
content: Footage broadcast on Jordanian state television showed three gunmen firing shots at a Greek Orthodox church in the city of Karak on Friday.

title: Is your Medicare Advantage plan ending next year? Here's what to know
content: Medicare open enrollment runs through Dec. 7, and for as many as 5 million seniors, it will be important to log on and pick a new plan.

title: U.S. birth rate drops to record low, but older women are having more babies
content: The U.S. birth rate fell to its lowest level ever recorded, according to a report from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The drop would have been greater, but women over age 30 are having more children.

title: This decade has been missing its big-impact midterm
content: Every other decade over the past hundred years has produced at least one midterm that made a big difference in Congress and in national politics more broadly.

title: Drinking water supplies dwindle in Yemeni city besieged by Houthi rebels
content: Taiz, a city in southwestern Yemen, faces a severe water crisis as Houthi rebels backed by Iran tighten their encirclement. The city has struggled with water issues for over a decade, but the situation has worsened in recent weeks.
